resources.string: Enter your full name as it appears in the employee directory. HR will match your verified account to your employee profile.
Use 2–120 characters. Your name does not grant a role or create another login.
Your request is waiting for an HR review. Check your status after HR confirms your employee profile.
No reason was provided by the service. Contact HR for clarification.
Contact HR to review this decision. Another submission does not replace a rejection.
This email’s access needs an administrator review. HR may need to check the existing account link or access status. A new approval request cannot restore this access.
Continue to check your account access. Your authenticated session determines which attendance features are available.
The current decision could not be confirmed. Check approval status before sending another request. This does not mean your request was rejected.
Share your work email and the decision shown here with HR so they can review your employee profile or account link.
HR contact copied. Contact HR using your preferred email app.
An approval request does not mark attendance or start location sharing. Account binding remains in place when you sign out.
